title: Solving the pricing PDE and measuring local exposure
objectives: Transform the Black–Scholes terminal PDE into an initial heat equation and evaluate its kernel integral
Derive yield-adjusted Greeks with explicit time, decimal-parameter, and contract-multiplier units
Verify parity sensitivities and limiting behavior
Distinguish local neutrality and partial derivatives from finite market-scenario changes
prerequisites: Chapters 17–19: Gaussian kernel, Black–Scholes PDE and formula, self-financing; multivariable differentiation and Taylor expansion.
source_scope: Full official English captions at positions 49–50 read sequentially. No comprehensive audiovisual audit. Kernel uniqueness, time conventions, maturity sensitivity, strategy-neutrality labels, and financed condor profit are qualified; analytic Greek derivations anticipate the next recordings.
